fields.label: Projected CRS (EPSG)
fields.qualification: Derived from the recorded CRS label using the PROJ EPSG database; no numeric EPSG code is stored in either MDB. Confirm using original GPS/control points.

fields.label: CRS name
fields.qualification: Exact SAI_Control.ProjectionFile in both files. This confirms the label only, not its geographical correctness.

fields.label: Frequency (Hz)
fields.qualification: Exact SAI_Control.Frequency in both files. Retain 60 as source evidence; project frequency needs engineering confirmation.

fields.label: Supply voltage, line-to-line (kV)
fields.qualification: Exact InstFeeders.NominalKvll. BusVoltageLevel is separately 11.37 and is not the nominal-voltage field.

fields.label: LT secondary voltage, line-to-line (kV)
fields.qualification: Not established. NomKvMode=C and SpecNomKv=4.16 are recorded, but mode meaning/library voltage must be checked. PTSecondary=120 is a separate control field. The earlier 0.4kV Data Entry export convention is not evidence from these MDBs.

fields.label: Projection WKT / reference
fields.qualification: ProjectionWKT is an empty string in both files. Optional; leave blank when reproducing the source.

fields.label: Approved MDB template
fields.qualification: Application-specific registered template ID is not contained in a reference MDB. Select an approved, clean template with the matching schema; do not use a populated source file as the template.

fields.label: Conductor library revision
fields.qualification: Not stored. Referenced conductor names are present, but definitions and library revision are absent.

fields.label: Transformer library revision
fields.qualification: Not stored. Referenced transformer name is present, but its library revision and electrical definition are absent.

fields.label: Line configuration library ID
fields.qualification: Exact ConfigurationId on all 19 sections. It is an identifier; the voltage-looking text is not the network nominal supply voltage.

fields.label: Transformer supply conductor library ID
fields.qualification: Candidate family only: supply R/B are DOG, Y is ' DOG' with one leading space; neutral is blank. Verify literal IDs/alias policy in the installed library.

fields.label: Transformer secondary-link conductor library ID
fields.qualification: Candidate family only: link R/B are ANT, Y is ' ANT'; SectionPhases=RYBN but the neutral ID is blank. Resolve the neutral and whitespace policy.

fields.label: Phase-to-phase spacing (cm)
fields.qualification: Exact PhaseToPhaseSpacing_MUL on all sections. The application labels this field cm; the MDB declares Metric globally and provides no field-level unit annotation. Confirm the spacing unit before approval; no conversion was applied.

fields.label: Phase-to-neutral spacing (cm)
fields.qualification: Exact PhaseToNeutralSpacing_MUL; same spacing-unit qualification applies.

fields.label: Average conductor height (m)
fields.qualification: Exact AveHeightAboveGround_MUL; Metric is recorded. This is model conductor height, not an individual surveyed pole height.

fields.label: Survey pole-height unit
fields.qualification: These electrical models do not establish the paper form's pole-height unit. Current PDF Data Entry saves feet under the existing application policy; that policy comes from the application, not these MDBs.

fields.label: Two-digit survey-year window starts at
fields.qualification: Not established. Historical model-year labels 2015-2025 are not a DDMMYY interpretation policy.

fields.label: Transformer capacity to library type
fields.qualification: Candidate mapping inferred from the type label only. Both instances use '100 KVA'; verify its capacity and electrical definition in the selected library. No other capacities are established by these two files.

fields.label: Approved demand method
fields.qualification: No approved application demand method is stored. Existing rows use fractional equal phase allocation, which differs from the application's whole-customer balancing method.

fields.label: Blank consumer cells
fields.qualification: The files contain numeric model loads, not the original blank paper cells. They do not establish this policy. The Data Entry MDB export-only zero rule does not automatically approve this final-generation setting.

fields.label: Category kVA and power-factor rates
fields.qualification: No RS/RL/SC/LC/SI/LI/PB/AG/ST/PV rate table is present. Observed aggregate ratio is 3 kVA/customer for 39 nonzero phase records, but power factor cannot be established from positive kVA with zero kW/kvar.

fields.label: Demand method evidence
fields.qualification: This review supplies observed load evidence, not an approved demand standard. Document the selected method and its approval separately.

fields.label: Advanced electrical mapping
fields.qualification: 133 cross-file consistent nonblank, non-instance parameters are in engineering-analysis.json. Review these observations and role-dependent settings before populating the advanced mapping; survey topology must come from the current network.

fields.label: Observed equipment references
fields.qualification: Literal names, including significant leading spaces, are in observed-equipment-references.json. They are references, not complete library contents.
